data_audit.label_coding: CONDITION 0 = liar (positive class), 1 = truth-teller; inferred from the abstract: liars slower (raw U RT 3759 vs 2140 ms) and flat pupil profile

B_fusion.desc: Published feature set (fusion), rebuilt from raw, LR/SVM chosen in inner CV

B_ocular.desc: Published feature set (ocular), rebuilt from raw, LR/SVM chosen in inner CV

B_rt.desc: Published feature set (rt), rebuilt from raw, LR/SVM chosen in inner CV

I7_lr_svm_rf_B_fusion.desc: Published 9 features, LR/SVM/RF chosen in inner CV

B_fusion_sheets.desc: Published feature set from the deposited sheets merged on SUBJECT_LABEL (pupil/blink ids offset)

I1_diff_ocular.desc: Levels + within-subject contrasts (U-C, E-C, U-E), ratios (RT), deviance in person-SD units

I1_diff_rt.desc: Levels + within-subject contrasts (U-C, E-C, U-E), ratios (RT), deviance in person-SD units

I1_diff_fusion.desc: Levels + within-subject contrasts (U-C, E-C, U-E), ratios (RT), deviance in person-SD units

I2_neutralz_subject_ocular.desc: (E or U mean - C mean) / SD of the person's own control trials

I2_neutralz_subject_rt.desc: (E or U mean - C mean) / SD of the person's own control trials

I2_neutralz_subject_fusion.desc: (E or U mean - C mean) / SD of the person's own control trials

I3_trial_neutralz_aggtuned_ocular.desc: Trial LR on E/U trials z-scored by own control trials; aggregation rule (mean/median/trim20/vote) tuned in inner folds

I3_trial_neutralz_aggtuned_fusion.desc: Trial LR on E/U trials z-scored by own control trials; aggregation rule (mean/median/trim20/vote) tuned in inner folds

I3_trial_raw_aggtuned_ocular.desc: Trial LR on all trials, no per-subject normalisation; aggregation tuned

I3_trial_raw_aggtuned_rt.desc: Trial LR on all trials, no per-subject normalisation; aggregation tuned

I3_trial_raw_aggtuned_fusion.desc: Trial LR on all trials, no per-subject normalisation; aggregation tuned

I3_trial_raw_mean_fusion.desc: Same as I3_trial_raw_aggtuned_fusion with aggregation fixed to mean (isolates the aggregation idea)

I5_ocular_plus_fixcount.desc: Ocular incl. fixation count per trial (RT proxy)

D_trial_pupil_only.desc: Trial LR, aggregation tuned; ablation of the ocular trial-level arm

D_trial_blink_any_only.desc: Trial LR, aggregation tuned; ablation of the ocular trial-level arm

D_trial_pupil_blinkrate.desc: Trial LR, aggregation tuned; ablation of the ocular trial-level arm

final.permutation_note: Label permutation of full nested pipeline, 1 repeat per draw; p=(1+#null>=obs)/(1+n). Eye-only and fixrate p are chance tests only; their signal is an RT proxy. RT permutation run by scripts/phase2_preti_perm_rt.py. seconds fields include a wall-clock jump (suspend) in the fusion entry.

efficiency.note: Fixation-level export, so sensor samples/s and real-time factor cannot be computed; throughput is per fixation row. Timings were taken on a CPU shared with other jobs, so treat them as upper bounds.
